Place two tables side by side and right-click one with scribing tools; it becomes the main block and keeps them.
Wand the runic matrix. Pillars are arcane stone bricks under arcane stone blocks; item pedestals can be added later.
jei.tc4modern.multiblock.infernal_furnac: Exactly one middle-layer edge centre is iron bars: the output side. The top centre must stay empty for input.
jei.tc4modern.multiblock.advanced_alchem: Wand an advanced or plain alchemical construct. The top centre is not checked; leave it empty.
jei.tc4modern.multiblock.thaumatorium.no: The clicked face is the front. The crucible stays and needs heat below; each adjacent mnemonic matrix adds 2 recipes.
jei.tc4modern.multiblock.node_jar.note: Build around an existing aura node, any wooden slabs on top. Wand-click middle or upper glass; the bottom layer cannot trigger it. 75% chance to weaken the node.
